text:
devon: taking over coverage now until 08:00 PT. quick watchlist for the shift:
- noisy kv-autoscale alerts in us-west-2 (many spurious scale_failures at 30m windows) :eyes:
- occasional model-server OOMs on quantized-v2 (node gpu-24, seems tied to long seq jobs)
- transient 503s from redis-proxy cluster (pod proxy-3) during rolling updates
- disk pressure on /var/lib/modelcache on gpu-24 (cache eviction not kicking fast enough)
- upload rate-limit spikes for customer uploads (rate limiter metric: uploads.per_min)

If anything critical, ping @mike or escalate to SRE paging. Leaving a few runbooks below.

anna: noted. I'll mute the noisy kv-autoscale alert rule if it keeps firing, but will check the scale logs first. also dropping a quick check command:
```
# check recent scale failures
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/kv-autoscaler --tail=200 | grep scale_failure
```

mike: thanks. FYI i'm available until 02:00 PT then offline. If kv-autoscale shows repeated errors >3 in 1h, 1) add suppression: set threshold 5m->15m in alerting, 2) file a follow-up ticket with autoscaler team. :thumbsup:

lena: dug into the model-server OOMs earlier — looks like one-off long generation jobs are causing KV cache to balloon. Temporary mitigation: reduce max_seq for quantized-v2 shards to 2048 and restart pods on gpu-24. Use this quick command if you need to roll a node:
```
kubectl rollout restart statefulset/model-server-quantized-v2 -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-24
```

devon: putting these small actions on my checklist: 1) monitor kv-autoscale for 30m, 2) patch alert thresholds if noise persists, 3) patch model-server max_seq on gpu-24 if OOM repeats, 4) watch disk pressure and clear old cache files if >85% usage.

oncall-bot: rotation scheduled: devon -> anna (backup) at 08:00 PT. Reminder: update the oncall doc after handoff.

anna: quick note — if you hit the redis-proxy 503s, do not restart cluster; instead scale proxy-3 to 0 then back to 1 to avoid losing sticky connections. command:
```
kubectl scale deployment/redis-proxy -n infra --replicas=0 && sleep 10 && kubectl scale deployment/redis-proxy -n infra --replicas=1
```

mike: leaving a small follow-up: i'll open a short postmortem draft if OOMs spike again. otherwise looks good. :shipit:

devon: thanks all. i'll update the oncall doc and ping in #eng-oncall if anything changes. leaving watchlist pinned in thread.
